result.one_liner: Google Ads API enables programmatic access to manage Google Ads accounts, campaigns, and advertising operations

evidence.quote: Use OAuth 2.0 to Access Google Ads API
Each developer token has an access level (Test, Basic, or Standard) which determines the number of API calls
A developer token is a 22-character alphanumeric string obtained from the API Center page
The Google Ads API can be called either using gRPC or REST

result.notes: Google Ads API requires OAuth2 authentication and a developer token. Free testing access available via Test Account Access, but production use (Basic/Standard access) requires application approval. API available via REST and gRPC with client libraries in multiple languages. No MCP server identified. Approval requirement classifies as yellow.
